create.name: Kristof Lambregts
create.bio:
Kristof Lambregts is a sound healer, musician and yoga teacher from Brecht, north of Antwerp in Belgium, who works under the name Akshara. Music has run through his life for more than twenty-five years, and he came to sound work by way of Nada Yoga, the yogic study of sound, before training professionally in sound healing, yoga and meditation. His own Hatha practice began years before he thought of teaching, and the teacher training he eventually took changed his direction. At the end of 2022 he also trained as a music producer so that he could record his sessions to a high standard and share them online.

Locally he holds group sound baths in studios around Brecht and Antwerp, opening with a short visualisation before the bowls, gongs and chimes take over, and he teaches a weekly Hatha class in Sint-Job that ends with singing bowls during the final rest. He also brings sound and yoga sessions to companies, retreats and private gatherings. Online, his Tune your Self community, started in January 2025, offers live sound baths, yoga and meditation with a library of recordings, and he runs a second community for people learning to become sound healers. His Insight Timer tracks feature Tibetan and crystal bowls, gongs and nature sounds.

courses.title: Group Sound Baths in the Antwerp Area
courses.description: Themed evening or afternoon sound journeys in yoga studios in Brecht, Ranst and Schoten. Each begins with a short guided visualisation, then moves into singing bowls, gongs and chimes, with time afterwards to come back and talk.

courses.title: Weekly Hatha Yoga in Sint-Job
courses.description: A Tuesday evening Hatha class in Sint-Job, Brecht, open to all levels with no fixed term. Postures and breathing are followed by a final relaxation accompanied by singing bowls.

courses.title: Tune your Self Online Community
courses.description: An online space with live sound baths, yoga and meditation sessions, a recordings library and a monthly theme. Members can also join short series on self-care practices.

courses.title: Sound and Yoga Sessions for Groups and Companies
courses.description: A sound bath, yoga session or both, arranged for a team day, a retreat, a studio or a private celebration. Sessions are held on site or at a venue he finds.

courses.title: Chakra Balancing Through Sound
courses.description: A nine-day Insight Timer course of about forty minutes a day, opening with an introduction to the chakras. Each following day gives one of the seven centres its own bowl and gong journey, and the last brings them all together.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Kristof Lambregts on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Sound baths with Tibetan and crystal bowls, gong baths, frequency tracks and soundscapes blended with rain or forest, plus short talks on his instruments. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Free Sound Bath
free_resources.description: A recorded sound healing session sent by email when you sign up to his newsletter. It is meant as an easy first taste of his bowl work.
